sessions.phase_label: Site handoff, domain launch, and lead-flow verification

requirements.title: One-Page SaaS Landing Page
requirements.definition: Provide a public one-page SaaS landing page composed from the supplied sections, copy, images, and brand assets.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers overall page composition only; visual styling, hero content, calls to action, contact behavior, and domain configuration are independently changeable Requirements.

requirements.title: Mobile-Responsive Landing Page
requirements.definition: Ensure the public landing page adapts appropriately to mobile displays.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently testable rendering behavior stated in the project description, distinct from depicting a mobile phone inside the hero artwork.

requirements.title: Hero Headline and Body Copy
requirements.definition: Display the client-selected headline and explanatory product copy in the landing-page hero section.
requirements.boundary_note: Hero wording changes independently of the hero artwork and therefore owns a separate lifecycle.

requirements.title: Hero Product Visualization
requirements.definition: Present a hero visual that depicts the DriveReel sales-page experience on a mobile phone, including representative vehicle imagery and action buttons.
requirements.boundary_note: The hero asset, launch-video availability, mobile-device framing, and depicted product controls are attributes of one independently evolving visual mechanism.

requirements.title: Bottom Founder Section Image
requirements.definition: Use the client-selected photo in the founder or bottom section of the landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: This asset can be replaced without changing the hero visualization or general page style.

requirements.title: Dealer Login Button
requirements.definition: Provide a Dealer Login button in the top-right area that navigates to the supplied dealer administration login URL.
requirements.boundary_note: Button placement and destination are attributes of one navigation action; the early-access action has a different destination and behavior.

requirements.title: Request Early Access Navigation
requirements.definition: Make the Request Early Access action navigate users to the contact page containing the early-access form.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers CTA routing only; contact-page wording and form submission behavior can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Privacy Policy Access
requirements.definition: Provide a publicly accessible Privacy Policy page or section for the landing site.
requirements.boundary_note: This independently required legal-information destination is stated in the project description and does not depend on the contact-page implementation.

requirements.title: Cost-Effective Webflow Hosting Plan
requirements.definition: Host the marketing site using the least costly suitable Webflow site plan, ultimately identified as the Basic plan.
requirements.boundary_note: Plan selection is a persistent hosting configuration choice; domain destinations and DNS routing are independently changeable.

requirements.title: Marketing Site Custom Subdomain
requirements.definition: Publish the Webflow marketing site on its own custom subdomain, ultimately get.drivereel.example, without taking over the product's existing root-domain routing.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the marketing site's own destination and DNS connection; restoration of the product root and www routes has separate failure and recovery trajectories.

requirements.title: Product Root-Domain Routing
requirements.definition: Preserve or restore drivereel.example so existing customer-facing DriveReel product links continue to reach the product hosted outside Webflow.
requirements.boundary_note: The root product route failed when the marketing site launched and was later restored independently of both the marketing subdomain and the www alias.

requirements.title: Product WWW-Domain Routing
requirements.definition: Configure www.drivereel.example in Firebase Hosting so it resolves correctly, including the intended redirect to the existing product root site.
requirements.boundary_note: The www path remained broken after the root domain was restored, demonstrating an independent configuration and verification trajectory.

requirements.title: Webflow Site Ownership Handoff
requirements.definition: Transfer the completed Webflow site into the client's workspace so the client owns and can administer the executable site artifact.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a task-local executable-artifact delivery obligation rather than a generic project-management handoff.

requirements.title: Site Editing Instruction Recording
requirements.definition: Deliver a Loom recording that explains how the client can make future site changes independently.
requirements.boundary_note: The recording is an independently requested deliverable artifact and is separate from transferring ownership of the Webflow site.

requirements.title: Clean Minimal SaaS Visual Style
requirements.definition: Render the landing page with the supplied branding, a clean minimal SaaS aesthetic, Loom-inspired styling, and no animations.
requirements.boundary_note: Brand colours, reference styling, and the no-animation constraint jointly define the page's visual treatment; individual content and image choices remain separate.

requirements.title: Landing Page Animation Policy
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: Founding Dealer Contact Page Copy
requirements.definition: Present the Founding Dealer headline and explanatory early-access copy on a contact page while offering only the contact-request path rather than separate email or phone actions.
requirements.boundary_note: Page copy and available contact methods are presentation choices separate from the fields, delivery recipients, and execution of form submissions.

requirements.title: Contact Page Action Options
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: Contact Form Lead Delivery
requirements.definition: Capture the specified dealership lead fields and comment through the contact form and deliver submitted leads to the designated recipient email addresses.
requirements.boundary_note: The field schema, recipient list, and successful end-to-end lead delivery are tightly coupled parts of one independently testable form workflow.

requirements.title: Contact Form Field Capture
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Good news, https://drivereel.example is back up. I restored the DNS records and the site is serving normally again.

One thing left: https://www.drivereel.example. The DNS is pointing to Firebase correctly, but the domain itself got dropped from the Firebase Hosting config, so it shows a "Site Not Found" page. I don't have access to Firebase, so I can't add it back — but it's a quick fix on your side:

1\. Go to <http://console.firebase.google.com|console.firebase.google.com> and open the DriveReel project
2\. In the left menu, click Hosting
3\. Find the drivereel-main site and click "Add custom domain"
4\. Enter: https://www.drivereel.example
5\. Choose the option to redirect it to an existing site, and select https://drivereel.example
6\. Click through to finish — the DNS records it asks for are already in place, so you can just confirm

The SSL certificate takes a few hours to issue after that, so www may show a warning until it's done. Nothing else needs changing.

Let me know once it's added and I'll verify it's resolving correctly.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports restoring the DNS records and observes that https://drivereel.example is back up and serving normally.
